Author: NeonGhostCinnamon
Name: Will-o-Patchwisp
Punchline: Patch notes for your Dalamud plugins.
Description: Shows the changelogs of your Dalamud plugins when they update (falling back to GitHub releases when a plugin has none), lists and installs updates waiting in your plugin repositories, and shows the current changelog of every installed plugin. Open it with /patchwisp.
Changelog:
First public release of Will-o-Patchwisp: patch notes for your Dalamud plugins.

- Changelogs when your plugins update, with a history
- Available updates with one-click install (or update all)
- Current changelog of every installed plugin
- GitHub release notes when a plugin has no changelog
- Ignore list, light and dark theme, compact minimized bar
- Ko-fi and GitHub buttons
